name: driftglass
description: Personal intelligence for standing questions: chosen sources become developing Stories, current cited answers, connected memory, decisions, forecasts, Intelligence Packs, and one workspace per Mission.

scripts.typecheck: npm run migrations:check && npm run types:check && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run migrations:check && npm run relay:assets:check && npm run lenses:check && npm run intelligence-packs:check && npm run social-card:check && npm run test:compile && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run generate:migrations && npm run sync:relay && npm run sync:lenses && npm run sync:intelligence-packs && npm run types:check && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lab:typecheck:offline && npm run agent-memory:typecheck:offline && node scripts/verify-repo.mjs
scripts.check:startup:staging: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && wrangler check startup --env staging --outfile dist/worker-startup-staging.cpuprofile
scripts.check:deploy: npm run check && npm run check:startup && npm run check:startup:staging && wrangler deploy --env="" --dry-run --outdir dist/dry-run && wrangler deploy --env staging --dry-run --outdir dist/dry-run-staging
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env="" && npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run r2:lifecycle
scripts.deploy:first: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env="" --secrets-file .deploy-secrets && npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run r2:lifecycle
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging && npm run db:migrate:staging && npm run r2:lifecycle:staging
scripts.deploy:staging:first: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging --secrets-file .deploy-secrets.staging && npm run db:migrate:staging && npm run r2:lifecycle:staging
scripts.selfhost:init: npm run selfhost:build --silent && node dist/selfhost/driftglass-selfhost.mjs init

DRIFTGLASS_SECRET.description: Required owner secret. Generate a long random value with `openssl rand -hex 32`. It protects the dashboard and independently derives private read and operations capability URLs.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional GitHub token for higher GitHub Releases rate limits. Leave blank for the zero-config public path.

OPENALEX_API_KEY.description: Optional free OpenAlex account key. OpenAlex requires authentication for every API request; leave blank to defer OpenAlex sources while all other cloud lanes continue.

DEEP_DIVE_LAB_URL.description: Optional URL of Driftglass Computer Power Mode, a separately deployed @cloudflare/computer dual-isolate workspace for advanced Mission and Story transforms.

DEEP_DIVE_LAB_TOKEN.description: Optional shared token used by the core Worker to create and read Computer Power Mode workspaces.
